snippet.title: Bros Survivors: Announcement Trailer | New Co-op Horde Survivor Game
snippet.description:
Free demo in Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3164070/Bros_Survivors/ 

Two players, one body, absolute chaos. Survive enemy hordes in this co-op Survivors-like. Merge with a friend into a giant mech: one controls horizontal movement, the other vertical. Will you coordinate or die trying?
